title: Hitmarker
blurb: Sharp, dry, and stacked twelve deep in every montage ever uploaded. Call of Duty's hitmarker confirms a shot connected, and MLG editing culture turned that small tick into an entire visual language — quickscopes, Doritos, air horns and this sound repeated until it becomes rhythm. It is arguably the defining audio artefact of 2010s YouTube gaming. Use it for direct hits of any description: a comeback landing, a roast connecting, a dodgeball finding its target. The crunchier the stack, the harder the play is understood to be.
origin: The shot-confirmation tick from Call of Duty, core of MLG montage culture.
